coverage.name: Clear Creek County
limitations: Rechecked 2026-10-12, after ballots were mailed: the Clear Creek County Clerk and Recorder page still posts no sample ballot, ballot-content certification, TABOR notice or participating-entities list for November 3, 2026; its only election links are voter registration, BallotTrax and a results page. The county Public Notices page and the county Document Center files posted since July 2026 (IDs up to 16876) include no election notice.

No entry created: Resolution R-26-55 in the Board of County Commissioners' September 1, 2026 agenda packet (https://www.clearcreekcounty.us/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Item/11382?fileID=23240) refers "Clear Creek County Ballot Issue 1 A -- Lodging Tax Revenue – Additional Allowable Uses and Allocations" to the November 3, 2026 election. The packet copy has an unsigned adoption block, the September 1 minutes were not posted, and the agenda lists a formal objection to R-26-55, so adoption and ballot placement are not confirmed by an official ballot or notice. Resolution text of the question: "SHALL CLEAR CREEK COUNTY LODGING TAXES BE INCREASED BY $800,000.00 ANNUALLY COMMENCING ON JANUARY 1, 2027, AND BY WHATEVER AMOUNTS ARE RAISED ANNUALLY THEREAFTER, BY INCREASING THE LODGING TAX RATE FROM TWO PERCENT (2%) TO SIX PERCENT (6%) ON THE RENTAL FEE, PRICE, OR OTHER CONSIDERATION PAID OR CHARGED FOR THE LEASING, RENTAL, SALE OR FURNISHING OF A ROOM OR ACCOMMODATION FOR A SHORT-TERM PERIOD OF LESS THAN THIRTY (30) CONSECUTIVE DAYS IN CLEAR CREEK COUNTY, EXCLUDING THE MUNICIPALITY OF THE TOWN OF GEORGETOWN THAT CURRENTLY HAS ITS OWN ADOPTED LODGING TAX, AND SHALL THE ALLOCATION OF COUNTY LODGING TAX REVENUE BE MODIFIED SO THAT THE REVENUE COLLECTED FROM THE SIX PERCENT (6%) COUNTY LODGING TAX SHALL BE USED AS FOLLOWS: • UP TO 60% OF THE REVENUE FOR PUBLIC INFRASTRUCTURE MAINTENANCE OR IMPROVEMENTS; AND ENHANCING PUBLIC SAFETY MEASURES; • AT LEAST TWENTY PERCENT (20%) OF THE REVENUE TO PROVIDE CHILDCARE FOR THE TOURISM-RELATED WORKFORCE, INCLUDING SEASONAL WORKERS, AND FOR OTHER WORKERS IN THE COMMUNITY; • AT LEAST TEN PERCENT (10%) OF THE REVENUE TO PROVIDE HOUSING FOR THE TOURISM-RELATED WORKFORCE, INCLUDING SEASONAL WORKERS, AND FOR OTHER WORKERS IN THE COMMUNITY; • AT LEAST TEN PERCENT (10%) OF THE REVENUE FOR ADVERTISING AND MARKETING OF LOCAL TOURISM, AS REQUIRED BY STATE LAW; AND WITH ALL SUCH EXPENDITURES SUBJECT TO AN ANNUAL INDEPENDENT AUDIT AND SPENT IN COMPLIANCE WITH LOCAL GOVERNMENT BUDGET LAWS, AND SHALL THE FIRST-YEAR REVENUE, AND WHATEVER ADDITIONAL AMOUNTS ARE RAISED ANNUALLY THEREAFTER, BE COLLECTED AND SPENT AS A VOTER APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE NOTWITHSTANDING ANY LIMITATION OR CONDITION UNDER ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE COLORADO CONSTITUTION OR ANY OTHER PROVISION OF LAW?"
Recheck when the county posts its sample ballot or TABOR notice; if 1A appears, create an entry (it earmarks lodging tax revenue for housing).

Board of County Commissioners agendas of September 8 through October 14, 2026 (checked 2026-10-10) contain no further action on R-26-55; minutes of the September 1, 2026 meeting are still not posted. The October 6, 2026 agenda refers to Clear Creek School District ballot measure 4A (a school district measure, not a county question).

Rechecked 2026-10-12: Board of County Commissioners minutes for September 1, 2026 are still not posted, so the adoption of Resolution R-26-55 (Ballot Issue 1A, lodging tax) is still not confirmed by an official ballot, notice or minutes. The October 13, 2026 agenda (Mayors and Commissioners meeting) has no ballot item. No entry was created; the note above stands.
